title: PowerUp Skills-QE&D
content:
PowerUp Skills are essential Soft Skills or Employability Skills that focus on an individual's non-technical abilities. These skills play a critical role in candidate selection during interviews and drive professional growth throughout your career.

In today's competitive job market, these competencies are key to success. Studies show:

  • 92% of hiring managers value non-technical skills as much as technical expertise
  • 57% of employers prioritize strong interpersonal and problem-solving abilities.
   [metform form_id="1947"]

PowerUp Skills Programs with QE&D

At QE&D, we offer two distinct PowerUp Skills programs designed to boost your employability, career readiness, and workplace performance — whether you're a fresher entering the job market or an experienced professional aiming for growth.

Program for Fresh Graduates and First-Time Job Seekers

This training focuses on 7 essential core competencies that top recruiters value beyond technical skills. These include:

  • Communication

  • Critical thinking

  • Teamwork

  • Cultural fit and motivation

  • Work ethic

  • Learning agility

  • Professionalism

These non-technical skills or soft skills are often the deciding factor in interview selections and are proven to impact job performance significantly.

Course Duration: 8 hrs

Course Fee: INR 3999/- + 18% GST

Program for Experienced Professionals

This advanced training track is tailored specifically for working professionals who are ready to elevate their impact and accelerate their career trajectory. It focuses on mastering 12 essential soft skills that are critical for leading teams, driving collaboration, and navigating real-world workplace challenges with confidence.

Key competencies developed include:

  • Strategic Thinking

  • Conflict Resolution 

  • Leadership and Influence 

  • Client and Stakeholder Management 

  • Effective Delegation 

  • Emotional Intelligence 

  • Change Management 

  • (...and more!)

 

Course Duration: 16 hrs

Course Fee: INR 6999/- + 18% GST

title: Interview Preparation Online Training
content:
Interview Preparation Online Training

Introduction to Interview Training

  • Overview of Interview Training
  • Purpose and goals of the training
  • Importance of effective interviewing skills
  • Common interview formats (e.g., one-on-one, panel, virtual, etc.)
  • Setting Expectations
  • Key outcomes of the training
  • What participants will learn and apply

Course Outline

Preparing for the Interview
  1. Understanding the Role & Company
    • Researching the job description and company values/culture
    • Understanding the industry and trends
    • Aligning personal skills with the job requirements
  2. Common Interview Formats
    • Behavioral vs. technical interviews
    • Situational questions vs. competency-based questions
    • Panel vs. one-on-one interviews
  3. Crafting Your Story
    • Developing a personal elevator pitch
    • Highlighting key achievements and experiences
    • Structuring your story using the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result)
Interview Skills Development
  1. Body Language & Presentation
    • Maintaining good posture and eye contact
    • Appropriate gestures and facial expressions
    • Managing nervousness
  2. Communication Techniques
    • Active listening
    • Clear and concise responses
    • Avoiding filler words
  3. Answering Common Interview Questions
    • “Tell me about yourself”
    • “Why do you want to work here?”
    • “What are your strengths and weaknesses?”
    • Responding to unexpected or difficult questions
Behavioral Interviews: The STAR Method
  1. Introduction to the STAR Method
    • How to structure responses using STAR
    • Emphasizing key skills and experiences
  2. Practicing STAR Responses
    • Breaking down real-life examples
    • Developing concise, effective stories
    • Role-playing and mock interviews
Quality Professionals Interview
  1. Common QA questions
Virtual Interview Tips
  1. Best Practices for Virtual Interviews
    • Setting up your environment (lighting, background, sound)
    • Camera positioning and eye contact through the screen
    • Technology checks and contingency plans for technical issues
  2. Engaging in Virtual Interviews
    • Adapting body language and facial expressions online
    • Building rapport with interviewers virtually
  3.  
Mock Interviews and Feedback (1 hr)
  1. Conducting Mock Interviews
    • Simulated interviews with peers or trainers
    • Role-playing exercises for both behavioral and technical questions
  2. Giving and Receiving Feedback
    • How to deliver constructive feedback
    • Using feedback to improve performance

Course Duration

6 classes,
2 hrs each class

Pricing

INR 8,500/- + 18% GST[metform form_id="1960"]
